evidence.reason: The implementation substitutes the raw escaped instance for both `%i` and `%I`. systemd defines `%i` as the escaped instance and `%I` as the unescaped instance, so `Service=%I.service` in `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket` should resolve to `crq-tick.service`; the current scan yields `crq\x2dtick.service` and misses the target. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the intended dependency scan, and the smallest fix is to unescape only the `%I` replacement.
